meta.title: Jewellery Store Management Software | Billing, Stock & Accounting | DigIT-Hack
meta.description: DigIT-Hack Jewellery Management Software helps jewellers manage billing, metal rates, stock, karigar accounts, udhaar, reports and customer communication in one secure system.

hero.headline: Smart Jewellery Store Management Software
hero.subLine: Complete solution for jewellery billing, inventory, metal rates, customer management and accounting — built specially for jewellers.

blocks.title: Complete Jewellery Business Management
blocks.content: Designed specifically for jewellery businesses, our software simplifies billing, stock control, metal rate management and financial tracking. Manage your entire showroom operations accurately and securely from one powerful dashboard.

items.title: Jewellery Sell / Purchase Billing
items.description: Generate accurate bills with metal rates, making charges, wastage and GST calculations.

items.title: Invoice Customization
items.description: Customize invoice formats with your logo, pricing structure and tax details.

items.title: Order Management
items.description: Manage custom jewellery orders, advances and delivery tracking easily.

blocks.title: Inventory & Stock Control
blocks.content: Track fine jewellery, raw metals and stones with complete precision. Maintain separate stock for retail jewellery, raw materials and stones with automatic updates after every transaction.

items.title: Retail Stock Management
items.description: Manage fine jewellery, raw gold, silver and stones with real-time tracking.

items.title: Tagging & Barcoding
items.description: Generate barcode tags for fast billing and easy product identification.

items.title: Stock Master Management
items.description: Maintain master records for categories, designs and item specifications.

items.title: Customer / Supplier / Karigar Management
items.description: Maintain complete records of customers, suppliers and karigars with transaction history.

items.title: Udhaar / Advances Management
items.description: Track credit balances, advances and pending payments accurately.

items.title: User Reference / Relations
items.description: Manage referrals and relationship tracking to build long-term customer trust.

items.title: Accounting
items.description: Maintain complete financial records including income, expenses and balance summaries.

items.title: Day Book / Daily Cash Reports
items.description: Monitor daily cash transactions and financial activity with automated reports.

items.title: Daily / Monthly / Yearly Reports
items.description: Access detailed sales and purchase reports for better business decisions.

items.title: User Expense Management
items.description: Track daily business expenses and maintain accurate financial control.

items.title: Daily Metal Rates Management
items.description: Update gold and silver rates daily for accurate billing and valuation.

items.title: SMS / WhatsApp Feature
items.description: Send invoices, reminders and promotional messages directly to customers.

items.title: Reminder Options
items.description: Set payment and order reminders for customers to improve follow-ups.

items.title: Auto Data Backup
items.description: Secure cloud backup keeps your jewellery business data safe at all times.

blocks.title: Ready to Simplify Your Jewellery Business Management?
blocks.content: DigIT-Hack Jewellery Management Software is secure, accurate, and fully customizable to match your showroom workflow. Whether you run a single jewellery store or manage multiple branches, easily handle inventory, billing, customer records, and reports from one reliable system designed for precision and efficiency.
